open_case: When ready, explicitly Start Investigation and document the review; opening assistance does not start it.
critical_route: Review the recorded Critical Escalation reasons and affected asset urgency; any containment recommendation still requires human approval.
unknown_needs_expert: Inspect the primary and supporting Suricata signatures and raw evidence; preserve Unknown / Needs Expert until evidence supports a human Finding.
Compare conflicting classification matches and document uncertainty without asserting maliciousness.
brute_force: Inspect authentication attempt frequency, target accounts and success or failure evidence where available.
Check authorized authentication activity and source ownership before drawing a conclusion.
web_attack: Inspect available HTTP request details, target application and signatures for the suspected web attack.
Check application logs and expected testing or scanner activity where authorized.
reconnaissance_port_scan: Inspect target ports, hosts and timing for possible reconnaissance.
Check whether the source is an authorized scanner before drawing a conclusion.
informational: Review the informational or policy signal in its operational context; do not assume an attack.
Confirm expected application or policy activity with the responsible owner where available.
generic_known: Inspect the normalized attack category together with native signatures and raw evidence.
Check source and destination context and seek corroborating evidence before drawing a conclusion.
